episode.episode_title: The courtroom showdown over the Online Safety Act
episode.episode_description: Meta, Roblox, and Quora are taking Ofcom to court over their new regulatory status. We look at why the UK's safety framework is hitting a legal wall.

selected_story.headline: Big Tech takes the UK's Online Safety Act to court
selected_story.source_title: Meta challenges Ofcom's OSA categorization of WhatsApp and Instagram imposing additional regulations; Roblox and Quora are also challenging their categorization (Daniel Thomas/Financial Times)

short.title: Big Tech takes the UK's Online Safety Act to court
short.description:
Category 1 status imposes stringent duties on platforms regarding illegal content and fraudulent advertising; a successful challenge could significantly delay or reshape the implementation of the UK's safety framework.
